categories.name: Boxes & cartons
categories.intro: Plain corrugated boxes for posting, shipping and storing. Single-wall cartons suit everyday parcels up to around 15 kg, double-wall cartons take heavier and more fragile loads, and crash-lock mailers fold up in seconds without tape. Every box here is made from kraft board with recycled content and goes straight into kerbside cardboard recycling once it has done its job.
categories.description: Single-wall and double-wall cartons, crash-lock mailer boxes and archive boxes in packs, priced ex VAT with bulk discounts and next-day dispatch.

categories.name: Mailing bags & envelopes
categories.intro: Lightweight ways to post clothing, books, prints and paperwork. Choose recycled polythene bags for soft goods that need to stay dry, padded and honeycomb paper mailers for small items that need a little cushioning, or board-backed envelopes for anything that must arrive flat. Each one closes with a peel-and-seal strip, so there is no tape to find at the packing bench.
categories.description: Recycled mailing bags, padded kraft mailers, honeycomb paper mailers and board-backed envelopes in trade packs with peel-and-seal closures.

categories.name: Paper bags
categories.intro: Counter bags and grocery bags for shops, delis, bakeries and market stalls. Striped and white sulphite bags hold sweets, pastries and small gifts; flat-bottom kraft bags stand up on the counter for loose groceries; window-front bags let customers see the bread before they buy it. All are made from paper and can go in kerbside recycling when clean.
categories.description: Striped and white sulphite counter bags, flat-bottom kraft grocery bags and window-front bakery bags in trade packs, priced ex VAT.

categories.name: Carrier bags
categories.intro: Carrier bags for shops that want customers to leave with something sturdy. Twisted and flat-handle paper carriers suit boutiques, gift shops and takeaway counters, while cotton totes and woven carriers are made to be used again and again. Paper carriers are recyclable at the kerbside; the reusable bags are built to last long enough that recycling is a distant question.
categories.description: Twisted-handle and flat-handle paper carriers, natural cotton totes and reusable woven carriers in trade packs with bulk pricing.

categories.name: Food packaging
categories.intro: Takeaway packaging for cafés, bakeries, delis and street-food traders. Kraft food boxes, double-wall hot cups, bagasse clamshells and greaseproof sheets are all suitable for direct food contact and sized for the dishes small kitchens actually serve. Product pages explain how each item can be disposed of, because a compostable clamshell and a paper cup need different bins.
categories.description: Kraft food boxes, double-wall hot cups, bagasse clamshells and greaseproof sheets for cafés and takeaways, in trade packs with bulk discounts.

categories.name: Gift & presentation boxes
categories.intro: Boxes that make a small product feel like a present. Magnetic-closure and rigid two-piece boxes suit candles, skincare and hampers; velvet-lined ring boxes hold jewellery securely; kraft pillow boxes fold flat and pop into shape for soaps, favours and sample sizes. Plain finishes mean they work with your own labels, ribbon or tissue.
categories.description: Magnetic gift boxes, rigid two-piece boxes, velvet-lined ring boxes and kraft pillow boxes for makers and gift shops, priced per pack ex VAT.

categories.name: Labels & tags
categories.intro: The small finishing pieces that every order needs. Thermal shipping labels run through direct thermal printers with no ink or ribbon, kraft swing tags and coloured tie-on tags carry prices and care notes, and round kraft seal stickers close tissue paper and bags neatly. Plain stock, ready for your own stamp, pen or printer.
categories.description: Thermal shipping labels, kraft swing tags, kraft seal stickers and coloured tie-on tags in rolls and packs, with bulk discounts ex VAT.

categories.name: Tape, wrap & void fill
categories.intro: Everything that keeps the contents of a box still and the box itself shut. Kraft paper tape seals cartons and goes into recycling with them, bubble wrap and honeycomb kraft wrap protect fragile pieces, and stretch film holds pallet loads together for collection. Choose paper-based options where you can, and plastic where moisture or weight makes it the better tool.
categories.description: Kraft paper tape, bubble wrap, honeycomb kraft wrap and pallet stretch film for packing benches and warehouses, priced ex VAT.

collections.name: New arrivals
collections.intro: The latest additions to the range, most of them plastic-free or made with recycled content. Paper-padded mailers, honeycomb wrap, kraft tape and compostable food packaging have joined the shelves this season, alongside a few small pieces that make a parcel look finished.
collections.description: New packaging at Boxes: honeycomb mailers, kraft paper tape, recycled mailing bags, bagasse clamshells and more, priced per pack ex VAT.

collections.name: Best sellers
collections.intro: The packaging our customers reorder most. Postal cartons, mailer boxes, padded mailers, shipping labels, tape and bubble wrap: the staples that keep a packing bench running from one week to the next.
collections.description: Our most reordered packaging: postal cartons, crash-lock mailers, padded mailers, thermal labels, tape and bubble wrap, with bulk discounts ex VAT.
